item.title: Police Respond To Harborough Rd Crash
item.description: Police say no-one was hurt after a crash involving two cars near Market Harborough this morning. It happened on the B6047 Harborough Road at the roundabout by the Harborough Innovation Centre at around 8.20am. Officers attended and the road was blocked for a time while the incident was dealt with and the vehicles recovered.
